3.	 Blood will be collected via finger stick at the following times: 
•	 Before consuming carbohydrate (T0)
•	 20 minutes after starting to consume carbohydrate (T20)
•	 40 minutes after starting to consume carbohydrate (T40) 
4.	 Conditions: timelines of both conditions are presented in Figure 3.2.
Exercise Condition: Pick a mode of exercise available in the lab, either treadmill or cycle 
ergometer. Measure T0 glucose, consume carbohydrate, begin exercising 10 minutes after 
consuming carbohydrate (T10) and continue exercising at a comfortable intensity for you, e.g. 
whatever you feel is moderate, for 30 minutes. After 10 minutes of exercise, pause briefly to 
measure blood glucose (T20), then continue for 20 more minutes (total exercise time = 30 
minutes minus a few seconds to measure glucose at T20).
No Exercise Condition: Measure T0 glucose, consume carbohydrate, and start the clock. Sit
